output.summary: The run is VALID and analysis coverage is COMPLETE, but the deterministic policy verdict is NO_POLICY. Both windows — reference (1767225600000–1767225720000) and evaluation (1767225720000–1767225960000) — report business_verdict NO_POLICY and resource_verdict NO_POLICY; no applicable business policy rule and no resource rule with effect 'sla' was evaluated, so no PASS/FAIL assertion was produced. Observed metrics are descriptive only: 0 errors, throughput ratios of 2400000/120000 and 4800000/240000 (equal to 20) against a constant 20 requests/s target, and latency p50 203 ms (reference) / 196 ms (evaluation) with p95 236 ms and p99 238 ms in both windows. The correlation pair resource-00 vs response_time_p95_ms is BELOW_EFFECT (raw/partial rho 0.0497, uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED), the headline was NOT_SELECTED (HOLM-adjusted p=0.465) and the requested control 'target' was dropped because it is constant (controls_used empty); the diagnostic summary reports anomalies_tested=0 with uncertainty NOT_ESTIMATED. Clock alignment is 'not_verified_by_core', so temporal ordering is unsupported. Healthy-looking numbers do not turn NO_POLICY into PASS.
